The '''Stand at Bhir'khi Pass''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]].

==The battle==
A small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vanguard force, consisting of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] and two [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]], was sent to seize [[Marter An]], the capital city and major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Sheris|planet]]. This strike team was supposed to take control of the spaceport and destroy the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] in order to allow the landing of the main invasion force before the organization of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] defense forces.<ref name="SWAJ9" />

But the [[New Republic Army]] was faster and sent a small group of vehicles to intercept them. The New Republic and Imperial forces fought in the [[Bhir'khi Pass]], a strategic access point to the capital.<ref name="SWAJ9" />
